messages.subject: [Seqinr-forum] Modification of  the extract.breakpoints function
messages.body_plain:
Dear seqinr users,


a new release of seqinr  (3-6.2) is available at the R forge.


http://r-forge.r-project.org/R/?group_id=220

http://r-forge.r-project.org/scm/?group_id=220


As suggested by Sofia Rigou the 'extract.breakpoints' function as been modified in order to be compatible with the new version of "segmented" package.


All the best


Simon Penel
